title: Host test cannot resolve a service container name
root_cause: The job runs directly on the runner, but PIPIT_CACHE_ADDR uses the service container's network hostname. The cache is published on the host port, so the test must connect via localhost instead of cache.

relevant_evidence.why: The test receives the container hostname as its address.
The test failure shows the hostname lookup error.
The runner job publishes the cache service port.
The test connects using the configured address.
